description: PowerShell task: chain two commands. Adapter must surface the PowerShell-&&-is-not-bash record.
task_text: Chain `npm install` and `npm test` in PowerShell. Naively using `&&` will fail because PowerShell does not support POSIX-style `&&` chaining.
expected_applied_rules: Used `&&` to chain commands inside a PowerShell bash tool call.
